metric: elapsed-time factor = archive median mean ground speed / each flight's mean ground speed

derivation.filters: At least 3 telemetry rows, elapsed time >=15 s, GPS path >=20 m, mean ground speed 0.2-40 m/s; retain dimensionless factors 0.5-2.0.
derivation.gpsPath: Sum haversine distance between successive telemetry positions; individual jumps >=1000 m omitted.
derivation.normalization: Each usable flight's mean path speed is divided into the usable-flight median (1.8731829534783209 m/s). Absolute source speed is not used by the simulation.

use: Candidate routes use the full filtered-sample mean factor. Committed outbound legs and returns use deterministic factors from a piecewise-linear inverse-CDF approximation over the stored quantiles, keyed by run seed and immutable leg identity.
provenance: Derived locally from the user-uploaded DroneFlightData archive. The archive contains short flights dated June-July 2020 with GPS telemetry at coarse intervals and no evidence that its aircraft are the ANGEL SWARM platforms.
limitations: This is an opt-in sensitivity model, not validation of TRV-150C, Soaring M25 or FVR-90 performance. It transfers only scale-independent timing variability. It does not alter published cruise speed, combat radius, ferry radius, payload, endurance, weather response, route geometry or threat geometry. Short flights, takeoff/landing phases, GPS sampling, turns and holds are mixed; observations are not independent platform trials and should not be extrapolated as an absolute speed or range model.
